{{Quote|Die, clone scum!!|Mrs. Katos|<ref name="This Precious Shining">{{CWACite|7|This Precious Shining}}</ref>}}
The [[Banker/Legends|banker]] [[Trillan Katos]] had a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''wife'''. With Trillan, she had [[Trillan Katos' older son|two]] [[Trillan Katos' younger son|sons]]. When their [[Unidentified war-torn planet|planet]] was subjugated to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Katos's wife shared her planet's anti-[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] stance. However, as opposed to participating in a battle against the Republic, she followed her husband's lead as they tried to leave their town. However, when they made it to a town plaza, they were caught in the crossfire of Republic and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] troops. When the droids killed the clone troopers, their cannon, and by extension their squad, was destroyed by [[Wes Apice]]. Wes, along with his brother [[Bryn Apice|Bryn]] and their friend [[Rayt (civilian)|Rayt]], a friend of the Katos family, then went to intercept Katos's wife and her family. Not recognizing them due to their [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] disguises, she and her family tried to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Rayt and his friends. No one was killed in the confrontation.
